closing_spikes.name: Blood Spike Arena
closing_spikes.description: A cursed arena ringed with dormant blood spikes waiting to snap shut.
closing_spikes.trigger: Touch the center cursed chest to start (skippable if left alone).
closing_spikes.hazard_desc: Outer spike rings erupt inward toward the center, dealing heavy HP damage to heroes while summoned monsters attack. Monsters are unharmed by blood spikes.
closing_spikes.reward_desc: Defeat every enemy in the chamber to disarm the spikes and unlock the cursed chest for bonus potions and coins.
closing_spikes.unlock_hint: Undiscovered event room. Enter a Blood Spike Arena chamber in the dungeon to record it.

wave_ambush.name: Cursed Ambush
wave_ambush.description: A suspiciously empty vault built to trap unwary fellowships inside.
wave_ambush.trigger: Touch the center cursed chest to seal all exits (skippable if left alone).
wave_ambush.hazard_desc: Sliding stone barriers lock every doorway while three pentagram waves materialize, culminating in double Necromancers and escorts.
wave_ambush.reward_desc: Survive all three waves to unseal the exits and unlock the cursed chest for bonus potions and coins.
wave_ambush.unlock_hint: Undiscovered event room. Enter a Cursed Ambush chamber in the dungeon to record it.

cursed_obelisks.name: Cursed Obelisks
cursed_obelisks.description: Four corner orb pedestals surround a cursed chest; exits stay open throughout.
cursed_obelisks.trigger: Touch the center cursed chest to awaken all four obelisks and their guards.
cursed_obelisks.hazard_desc: Active obelisks project purple tethers that grant nearby guards full damage immunity, though knockback, slow, and stun still work. Shatter all four orbs to expose them.
cursed_obelisks.reward_desc: Destroy every obelisk and clear the remaining guards to unlock the cursed chest for bonus loot.
cursed_obelisks.unlock_hint: Undiscovered event room. Enter a Cursed Obelisk chamber in the dungeon to record it.

rune_plates.name: Rune Plates
rune_plates.description: Three dormant arcane circles form a triangle around a cursed chest; exits stay open.
rune_plates.trigger: Touch the center cursed chest to awaken the circles and begin a steady enemy trickle.
rune_plates.hazard_desc: Stand inside any uncharged circle to fill it. Progress decays slowly outside and resets completely if you step onto a different circle. Each completed rune unleashes a knockback shockwave.
rune_plates.reward_desc: Completing the third rune triggers an arcane purge that banishes remaining foes and unlocks the cursed chest for bonus loot.
rune_plates.unlock_hint: Undiscovered event room. Enter a Rune Plates chamber in the dungeon to record it.
